• Infosys maintained its margins at 21% in FY26 and H1 FY27, delivering 20% to 22% for the year [T1 p.35, T3 p.9].
• Margins expanded by 50 basis points in FY25 [T1 p.35, T4 p.58].
• The company absorbed investments in sales and marketing, AI talent, and technology while maintaining these levels [T1 p.35, T3 p.9].
• Headwinds include acquisition-related costs and amortization (impacting margins by 50 to 70 bps), pricing pressure, and compensation rollouts in H2 [T1 p.35, T3 p.9].
• These headwinds are partially offset by Project Maximus and strict economic guidelines on client contracts [T1 p.35, T1 p.19].
• AI margins are not disclosed separately externally [T1 p.21].
